Secrecy Capacity & Coding for Noisy Quantum Wiretap Channels

Doctoral research at UM6P College of Computing investigating information-theoretic security bounds, wiretap channel models, and code construction for transmitting secure classical information over noisy quantum channels.

  • Characterization of private classical capacity and quantum secrecy bounds
  • Degraded and non-degraded quantum wiretap channel mathematical models
  • Design of polar and LDPC codes achieving wiretap secrecy capacity
